question: Under what condition must a hundred-thousand measure placed at the forehead-syllable mass be offered by one who has acted in service to the god-worshipped?
premises: A measure is situated at the forehead-syllable mass.
The count specified is a hundred-thousand units.
The action of offering follows from having completed the required act.
inference: The hundred-thousand measure at the forehead-syllable mass is to be offered by one who has completed the act, in relation to the god-worshipped.
uncertainties: The exact scope of the offering remains unspecified by this verse alone.
plain_english: One who has acted should offer a hundred-thousand placed at the mass of forehead syllables, O god-worshipped.
